name: Solr Standard
old_description: Clean, modern solar energy designed for today’s homes and tomorrow’s energy needs.
about:
Solr Standard is based in Warminster, Pennsylvania. The company was founded with the goal of delivering high-quality solar solutions without the confusion, pressure, or shortcuts often associated with the industry, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed.

The firm provides solar system design, project planning, and coordination services for residential, commercial, and energy storage projects. It works with a network of qualified installation partners to execute installations and also offers roofing services through Roofing Standard. The company emphasizes a thoughtful evaluation of each property, energy usage, and future goals to develop properly sized, efficient systems using premium panels, carefully selected inverters, and battery systems chosen for reliability.

Solr Standard serves homeowners, property managers, and business owners across Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Its project portfolio ranges from residential rooftop systems to commercial-scale solar arrays and battery backup installations, all supported by deep local knowledge of utility incentives, permitting requirements, and regional weather conditions.

The company differentiates itself through a simple, transparent process from consultation to completion, competitive pricing with smart system recommendations, and a commitment to long-term system performance and ongoing customer support.
